## Specification

### Component: Textarea

A native multi-line `<textarea>` that grows with its content, with an optional character counter.

#### Anatomy
```
<textarea class="ui-textarea [ui-textarea-sm|ui-textarea-lg]" data-autogrow style="--ui-textarea-rows:3">

<div class="ui-textarea-wrap">                         only with showCount
  <textarea class="ui-textarea" />
  <span class="ui-textarea-count" [data-state="near|limit"]>42 / 160</span>
</div>
```

#### Props
- `size`: `sm` · `md` (default) · `lg`. `autoGrow` (default true). `rows` (minimum lines, default 3). `maxRows` (cap, then scroll). `showCount`. `wrapperClassName`. All native textarea props, `ref` forwarded.
- Inside a Field it takes id, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `required`, `disabled` via `useFieldControl` (from `../field/field-context`); the counter id is appended to `aria-describedby`.

#### Behaviour
- Auto-grow: CSS `field-sizing: content` with `data-autogrow`. Where `CSS.supports('field-sizing', 'content')` is false, a layout effect sets `style.height = auto`, then `scrollHeight + border` on mount, on value change and on every input.
- `rows` sets `--ui-textarea-rows` (and the native `rows`); `maxRows` sets `--ui-textarea-max: calc(N * --ui-textarea-lh + 2 * --ui-textarea-py + 2px)`; above it the box scrolls (`overflow-y: auto`).
- Counter: length of `value` (controlled) or tracked from `onChange` (uncontrolled, seeded from `defaultValue`). With `maxLength` it reads `count / max`; `data-state="near"` at ≥ 90%, `"limit"` at 100%. Not a live region; it is in `aria-describedby`.

#### Visual rules
- Same surface as Input: 1px `--ui-border-strong`, `--radius-md`, bg `--ui-background` (dark: `--ui-foreground` 5% mix), `--ui-shadow-xs` (none in dark), text 14px with line-height 22px (`--ui-textarea-lh`), padding 8px 12px.
- Min height = rows × lh + 2 × py + 2px. `resize: none` while auto-growing, `vertical` otherwise.
- Sizes: sm 13px / lh 20px / py 6px / px 10px; lg 15px / lh 24px / py 10px / px 16px / `--radius-lg`.
- Hover (fine pointer), focus (border `--ui-ring` + 3px 25% ring), invalid (destructive), disabled (.5), read-only (muted fill) as Input.
- Counter: 12px, `tabular-nums`, right aligned, 6px below; `--ui-muted-foreground`, near `--ui-warning-text`, limit `--ui-destructive-text`.
- Touch: font-size 16px.

#### Motion
- Border, ring, background and counter colour transition 150ms `--ui-ease-standard`. The height is never animated (typing must not lag).

#### Accessibility
- Native textarea semantics; `maxLength` is enforced natively.

#### Acceptance checks
- A 3-line textarea is 84px tall (md); typing more lines makes it taller, and it stops at `maxRows` and scrolls.
- The counter updates as you type and its colour changes at 90% and 100%.
- Works inside a Field (label click focuses, hint / error / counter in `aria-describedby`).
- No axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/textarea/textarea.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useCallback, useId, useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent, type CSSProperties, type TextareaHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';

export interface TextareaProps extends Omit<TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>, 'size'> {
  /** Text size and horizontal padding: `sm` 13px / `md` 14px / `lg` 15px. Default `md`. */
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
  /** Grow with the content (CSS `field-sizing: content`, with a JS fallback). Default true. */
  autoGrow?: boolean;
  /** Minimum height in lines. Default 3. */
  rows?: number;
  /** Stop growing at this many lines and scroll instead. */
  maxRows?: number;
  /** Show a live character counter under the field (`42 / 280` when `maxLength` is set). */
  showCount?: boolean;
  /** Class for the wrapper that holds the counter (only rendered with `showCount`). */
  wrapperClassName?: string;
}

function supportsFieldSizing() {
  return typeof CSS !== 'undefined' && typeof CSS.supports === 'function' && CSS.supports('field-sizing', 'content');
}

/**
 * Textarea — multi-line text that grows with its content. Inside a <Field> it
 * picks up id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, required and disabled.
 */
export const Textarea = forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement, TextareaProps>(function Textarea(
  {
    size = 'md',
    autoGrow = true,
    rows = 3,
    maxRows,
    showCount = false,
    wrapperClassName,
    className,
    style,
    id,
    required,
    disabled,
    value,
    defaultValue,
    maxLength,
    onChange,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const countId = useId();
  const [length, setLength] = useState(() => String(value ?? defaultValue ?? '').length);
  const innerRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const composed = useComposedRefs(ref, innerRef);

  const control = useFieldControl(
    {
      id,
      required,
      disabled,
      'aria-describedby': props['aria-describedby'],
      'aria-invalid': props['aria-invalid'],
    },
    showCount && countId,
  );

  // JS fallback for browsers without field-sizing: measure and set the height
  const fit = useCallback(() => {
    const el = innerRef.current;
    if (!el || !autoGrow || supportsFieldSizing()) return;
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = `${el.scrollHeight + (el.offsetHeight - el.clientHeight)}px`;
  }, [autoGrow]);
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(fit, [fit, value, size, rows, maxRows]);

  const handleChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    setLength(e.target.value.length);
    fit();
    onChange?.(e);
  };

  const count = value !== undefined ? String(value).length : length;
  const ratio = maxLength ? count / maxLength : 0;

  const textarea = (
    <textarea
      ref={composed}
      rows={rows}
      maxLength={maxLength}
      value={value}
      defaultValue={defaultValue}
      onChange={handleChange}
      data-autogrow={autoGrow || undefined}
      className={cn('ui-textarea', size !== 'md' && `ui-textarea-${size}`, className)}
      style={
        {
          '--ui-textarea-rows': rows,
          ...(maxRows
            ? { '--ui-textarea-max': `calc(${maxRows} * var(--ui-textarea-lh) + 2 * var(--ui-textarea-py) + 2px)` }
            : null),
          ...style,
        } as CSSProperties
      }
      {...props}
      {...control}
    />
  );

  if (!showCount) return textarea;

  return (
    <div className={cn('ui-textarea-wrap', wrapperClassName)}>
      {textarea}
      <span
        id={countId}
        className="ui-textarea-count"
        data-state={ratio >= 1 ? 'limit' : ratio >= 0.9 ? 'near' : undefined}
      >
        {maxLength ? `${count} / ${maxLength}` : count}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/textarea.css`

```css
/* Textarea ----------------------------------------------------------------
   <textarea class="ui-textarea" data-autogrow style="--ui-textarea-rows:3">
   Grows with its content via field-sizing: content (JS fallback in the component).
   Optional: --ui-textarea-max (a length) caps the growth, then it scrolls.
   Sizes: -sm | (md) | -lg        States: :hover, :focus, [aria-invalid], :disabled, [readonly]
   Counter: <div class="ui-textarea-wrap"><textarea/><span class="ui-textarea-count">42 / 280</span></div>
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-textarea {
    --ui-textarea-bg: var(--ui-background);
    --ui-textarea-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
    --ui-textarea-lh: 1.375rem;
    --ui-textarea-py: 0.5rem;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: calc(var(--ui-textarea-rows, 3) * var(--ui-textarea-lh) + 2 * var(--ui-textarea-py) + 2px);
    max-height: var(--ui-textarea-max, none);
    padding: var(--ui-textarea-py) 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-textarea-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-textarea-bg);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--ui-textarea-lh);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    outline: none;
    resize: vertical;
    overflow-y: auto;
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-textarea {
    --ui-textarea-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 5%, transparent);
    box-shadow: none;
  }
  .ui-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }

  /* Auto-grow: the box follows the text; manual resizing would fight it */
  .ui-textarea[data-autogrow] { field-sizing: content; resize: none; }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-textarea:hover:not(:focus, :disabled, [readonly], [aria-invalid="true"]) {
      --ui-textarea-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-border-strong) 55%, var(--ui-foreground));
    }
  }
  .ui-textarea:focus {
    --ui-textarea-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-textarea[aria-invalid="true"] { --ui-textarea-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-textarea[aria-invalid="true"]:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 25%, transparent); }
  .ui-textarea:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; resize: none; }
  .ui-textarea[readonly] { --ui-textarea-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-surface-muted) 60%, transparent); }

  /* Sizes */
  .ui-textarea-sm { --ui-textarea-lh: 1.25rem; --ui-textarea-py: 0.375rem; padding-inline: 0.625rem; font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .ui-textarea-lg { --ui-textarea-lh: 1.5rem; --ui-textarea-py: 0.625rem; padding-inline: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); font-size: var(--text-md); }

  /* Counter */
  .ui-textarea-wrap { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-textarea-count {
    justify-self: end;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-textarea-count[data-state="near"] { color: var(--ui-warning-text); }
  .ui-textarea-count[data-state="limit"] { color: var(--ui-destructive-text); }

  /* iOS Safari zooms the page when a focused field is under 16px */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-textarea { font-size: 1rem; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Auto-growing textarea** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/textarea/auto-grow.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Textarea } from '@/ui/components/textarea';

export default function TextareaAutoGrow() {
  return (
    <Field className="w-full max-w-md">
      <Label>Meeting notes</Label>
      <Textarea
        maxRows={8}
        defaultValue={'Agenda for Tuesday\n- Review Q3 pipeline\n- Decide on the pricing page test'}
        placeholder="Type or paste your notes"
      />
      <FieldHint>Starts at three lines and grows to eight, then scrolls.</FieldHint>
    </Field>
  );
}
```
